title: Diffusion from first principles
hook: Destroy data with noise on purpose, learn to undo one step, and train a real model on a CPU.

verified.claim: Sohl-Dickstein et al. estimate a mean and a covariance for each Gaussian step, and Ho et al. set the covariance to untrained constants. Equations 4 and 14 of Ho et al. are as cited.
sigma is computed from alphas_cumprod as in the lesson.
The real sigma_min and sigma_max are 0.02917 and 14.6146.
EPS input is x / sqrt(sigma^2 + 1), and the clean estimate is x - sigma * output.
The chain and the jump agree, and the small network gets close to the data.

unchecked: The equation numbers and the claims about Ho, Sohl-Dickstein and Lin were checked when this lesson was first audited, and not read again this time.
The toy is one-dimensional, so it shows the mechanism and says nothing about image quality.
